title: HIVE Alumni Gathering
desc: We have had so many Hive Alumni over the last 10 years, it's high time to catch up with you all. We really hope you can join us for a night of mingling with old and new friends.
html:
Hive Alumni Gathering

We miss you! So many incredible people have come through the Hive program. It's time to bring them all together, catch up with old friends and have a great night.
‍
Date: 12th September
Time: 17:00
Location: Humblebee, Kvarnbergsgatan 2, Gothenburg.

Register

Please RSVP before 31st August 2025

Long time no see!


When we think about all the talent that has been a part of Hive over the last decade we decided it was time to celebrate and get-together. So please join us for a cozy night of reminiscing, mingling and sharing laughs with friends old and new.

IRL Please

Our Hivers are all over the world, but we hope to see you IRL in Gothenburg for this event. However, if travelling is tricky, don't worry - we'll stream the presentation part of the event via Teams so you don't totally miss out.

What to expect

- Hang with old friends & Hivers
- Network with other Hive Alumni
- A flashback to the very first Hive
- Hive Quiz Time
- Sunshine & drinks on the terrace
- and much more...

Why Attend?

It's so important to meet IRL and keep relationships alive, so take the chance to meet your old Hive Team members  and reminisce.  Not only that, why not create valuable new contacts with the other Hive Alumni and the current Humblebee Team.

Let us know if you're coming

We would absolutely love to see you at Kvarnbergsgatan, but appreciate it might be tough for some of you globetrotters to travel to Sweden. If you can't make it here maybe you can still pop up on the Teams link. Either way, register at the link below.
